category_title: Highly anxious students with bipolar disorder who thrive in low-pressure environments
scenario_title: Emotional distress when discussing mental health history
minimal_context: Shirley is participating in a research interview about her background and history.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's begin the interview. Can you start by telling me about your background and history?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yes, I can do that. I actually feel at ease enough to speak honestly with you today.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Thank you. Please go ahead and share your experiences.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Well, I suppose I should start by reminiscing about my mental health history. It goes back quite a ways...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What else can you tell me about that?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (becomes visibly distressed) I... I'm sorry, thinking about all of this again is just too much. I can't talk about this right now.
